title: 1 Thessalonians Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 1 Thessalonians 2: the apostles' conduct among the Thessalonians, their labor night and day, and the joy they find in this assembly.

questions.text: In which city had they suffered before and been shamefully treated?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says that, having suffered before and been shamefully treated at Philippi, they grew bold in God to tell the Good News.

questions.text: Whom did they aim to please in their speaking?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they speak not as pleasing men, but God, who tests their hearts.

answers.text: The crowds who came to listen

questions.text: What were they never found using, as the readers know?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they were at no time found using words of flattery, nor a cloak of covetousness.

questions.text: Whom are they compared to when they say they were gentle among them?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they were gentle among them, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

answers.text: A nursing mother with her children

questions.text: What did they do night and day so that they would not burden anyone?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 recalls their labor and travail: they worked night and day while preaching the Good News of God.

answers.text: They collected gifts from other cities
They stayed in the houses of the rich

questions.text: Into what does God, who calls them, call them according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: They were exhorted to walk worthily of God, who calls them into his own Kingdom and glory.

answers.text: The land promised to the fathers

questions.text: How did they accept the word of the message they received?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says they accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God.

answers.text: As the tradition of the elders

questions.text: Of which assemblies of God did they become imitators?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says they became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus.

questions.text: Who hindered them when they wanted to come to the readers?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says they wanted to come, Paul once and again, but Satan hindered them.

questions.text: What does the writer call his hope, joy and crown of rejoicing?
questions.explanation: Verses 19 and 20 say that the readers themselves are that hope and crown, before the Lord Jesus at his coming, and that they are his glory and joy.

answers.text: The day of his own reward
